title: Authentication screen: stop the cameras that render under the opaque full-screen background
runtimeWriters: Authentication.unity: Main Camera (line ~397) renders the world every frame; both canvases are Screen Space Overlay (m_RenderMode 0), so the UI does not need a camera; Background (line ~11937) covers the screen. In the real flow the Bootstrap cameras (DontDestroyOnLoad) also render; this bench opens the scene alone, so it measures only its own camera.
exposure: Authentication.unity, every launch, while the sign-in screen is up.
